The source document does not contain any tables. The JSON correctly reflects this with a table count of zero.

The reading order in the JSON follows the logical flow of the source document across all four pages. Multi-column layouts, such as the grid of images and text on Page 3 and the sidebar images on Pages 1 and 4, have been linearized in a way that preserves the intended relationship between the images and the surrounding text. The flow from definitions to risk factors to action items is correctly maintained.

The lists are converted accurately. The grid items on Page 3 (identifiable by checkbox icons in the source) are represented as list items. The goal-setting checklist on Page 4 is correctly grouped into a single list element containing three distinct items with the blank spaces ('_____') preserved from the source.

The single URL present in the document ('www.startwithyourheart.com' on Page 4) is correctly identified and linked. The pipeline successfully extracted the URL and added the 'https://' protocol to the href, which is a standard accessibility improvement. No fabricated links were added.

No organizational changes were found that confuse the meaning or intent of the document.
Neither the source PDF nor the converted HTML output contains any tables.
